operations.name: Debug Step In Targets

Refresh replaces the sole catalogue; handles expire on resume, a new stop, invalidation, capability/frame/thread/session changes or execution submission. Empty targets is an actual adapter result. operations.name: Debug Step Into Target

Consumes the complete catalogue before submission; no raw targetId, fabricated target, automatic retry, rollback, source Undo or cancellation after submission. Inspect debug_status.lastExecution for accepted/unconfirmed acknowledgement and wait for actual stopped events. Public execution arguments retain the issued handle, never the adapter ID.

operations.name: Debug Run To Cursor

Requires explicit observed sessionGeneration/stopGeneration/threadId, workspace path/one-based line, expectedDocumentId/expectedRevision from documents_read and expectedBreakpoints from debug_status.breakpoints[path] (empty if absent). Native source identity/revision/clean disk bytes are checked before arming and again before continuing; this does not prove source matches the compiled binary. Preserves all configured source breakpoints, reuses an unconditional destination breakpoint, rejects conditional/logpoint collisions and relocated/unverified/ambiguous verification. Optional singleThread needs its adapter capability; no granularity or arbitrary DAP fields. One continue acknowledgement appears in lastExecution; runToCursor reports lease/restoration and actual/unknown target hit. Restores the exact original list at the next actual stop, including earlier breakpoints/exceptions/pause. Late requests must settle before restoration; failed/uncertain cases stay leased until explicit repair or session stop. No saved breakpoint edits, cancellation after submission, automatic resume/retry or source Undo. Bounds: 1 MiB public request, 1000 total breakpoints including a new temporary point, 512 KiB reply, 256 deferred events/1 MiB/64 KiB each.

operations.name: Debug Restore Run To Cursor

Sends one full original-list replacement and validates its response. Does not resume, edit saved breakpoints, automatically retry or cancel an in-flight request. No granularity/singleThread, raw targetId, arbitrary source/command, automatic retry or source Undo. Consumes both target catalogues before submission. Acknowledgement is recorded as accepted/unconfirmed in lastExecution using only public handles. pendingStop blocks inspection/execution until the actual relocated stopped event; a missing event after 15 seconds reports unconfirmed without automatic continuation. operations.name: Workspace Counterparts
operations.description: Find C/C++ header/source companion files for an already-open saved workspace document. Requires current expectedRevision and expectedDocumentId; rechecks source lifetime/revision after metadata probes. No LSP, compiler, ripgrep, project-rule execution, recursive scan, source parsing, file edit/save or implicit document opening. Supports h/hh/hpp/hxx/inl versus c/cc/cpp/cxx/m/mm, and excludes .generated/.gen stems. Checks siblings, then the nearest Public/Private/Classes or include/includes versus src/source layout, retaining nested paths and paired-root fallbacks. Local probes try lower/upper extension variants. Also consults the already-current workspace file cache through a per-stem header/source offset index built during ordinary workspace_files refresh, without scanning or starting that refresh. Cached paths support other layouts and mixed-case extensions. Cached paths respect the file index ignore rules; explicit local probes do not. Missing, busy or stale caches are not used; current partial caches may contribute candidates. Rechecks watcher revision and cache generation after probing; changes mark the report partial. index reports missing/busy/stale/ready/partial/changed, revision and generation; zero means unavailable. ready covers the existing cached scope, not ignored files or semantic completeness. Same-stem names across modules are ambiguous; no semantic pairing. At most 16 ancestors, 128 copied cache matches and 128 unique total metadata probes; truncated/unreadable observations are explicit. Existing regular canonical targets remain inside the workspace; symlink files and outside targets are excluded. Duplicates use case-insensitive Windows path comparison or case-sensitive POSIX comparison. The GUI auto-opens only one unambiguous result with a complete unchanged cache and no limits/unreadable paths; otherwise shows the common palette with index status. No cache activation, edits or opening by SDK/ABI2 callers. Results are momentary and ordinary guarded opening may still fail.

operations.name: Workspace Include
operations.description: Find workspace files matching the literal C/C++ #include on the caret logical directive of an already-open saved workspace document, including unsaved buffer changes. Requires expectedRevision, expectedDocumentId and a valid UTF-16 position; rechecks source lifetime/revision. Returns the literal target, quote/angle kind, exact inner-header UTF-16 range on the actual physical header line (which may differ from the caret line) and the requested position. A bounded native lexical context scan excludes comment/string/raw-string bodies and continued non-directive lines; it does not evaluate conditions or expand macros. Ordinary literal #include directives support inline block comments between tokens and immediate backslash-LF/CRLF continuations, including a spliced include keyword. The caret may lie on any continued component; the header-name itself must remain on one physical line with forward-slash relative paths. Nonspliced multiline comments between tokens and continued header-name literals are refused. Prefix limit 1 MiB, total logical directive span 8 KiB, target 1024 UTF-8 bytes; malformed/unsupported contexts fail explicitly. Supports preceding ordinary comments/strings, common raw delimiters and escaped-newline context; unrecognized raw delimiters are refused. For quoted headers, probes the source-relative path first. Both forms also use suffix-component matches from the already-current workspace file cache, with Windows case-insensitive or POSIX case-sensitive comparison. Parent segments are followed only by the quoted source-relative probe; no cache suffix guessing for such paths. The shared per-stem index stores bounded header/source/other offset buckets, supporting extensionless and .inc headers without another scan. At most 128 cached bucket entries and 128 total unique metadata probes. Missing/busy/stale caches contribute no paths; partial current caches can contribute retained paths. Rechecks watcher revision/cache generation after probing and document-lock reacquisition. index/truncated/unreadable explicitly describe incomplete or changed coverage. Existing canonical regular targets remain inside the workspace; symlink files and external targets are excluded. Duplicate local/index paths retain source-relative provenance. ready covers the cached ignore scope, not compiler include-search order or semantic completeness. Multiple candidates remain ambiguous; the GUI auto-opens only one complete unchanged result and otherwise uses the shared palette with caret/tab/source guards. No compiler include-directory interpretation, external SDK lookup, include_next/import, project rules, LSP, process, recursive enumeration, cache refresh, edit/save or implicit opening by SDK/ABI2 callers. Results are momentary observations.

operations.name: Workspace Files
operations.description: Read a cached workspace path-index page, respecting ignore rules. Use nextOffset until null; refresh rebuilds the index. Each page reports both the watcher indexRevision and the actual cache rebuild generation. Validate both across pages: a manual rebuild may keep the same watcher revision while changing generation. A mismatch requires discarding or marking the assembly partial and retrying; offset pagination does not retain an issued frozen snapshot. Enumeration continues in one owned background stream, publishing sorted immutable batches. There is no total 200000-path, 32-MiB-output or 30-second cutoff. indexing=true means work is still running: consume the current pages, then poll from offset 0 until complete=true. indexError reports actual enumeration failures. Batch publications and refresh change generation; discard mixed page assemblies and retry. Page payloads remain bounded to 8 MiB and 20000 paths.

operations.name: Snippets Complete
operations.description: Read saved project, host-configured personal and active ABI2 plugin snippet catalogues for an already-open saved document. Merge order is project, personal, then plugins by order/id; duplicates retain cycodeSnippetSource provenance and owner labels. The optional personal store is fixed by the trusted embedding, shared across this installation and absent in a default Engine; no input path is accepted. Invalid personal storage is reported for repair, never silently omitted. result.cycodeUserRevision binds exact saved bytes; cycodeUserGeneration is local refresh metadata. User/registry changes are rechecked during issuance and native preparation, alongside the saved project catalogue, source/workspace/disk guards. Already prepared concrete plans retain ordinary apply guards. Required expectedRevision/UTF-16 position; optional ordered selection has the caret at an endpoint, at most 8 KiB of source and actual literal TM_SELECTED_TEXT use. Each catalogue accepts at most 256 KiB / 256 definitions / 8 KiB bodies, 16 prefixes per definition; plugin registry is 32 catalogues / 1 MiB including inactive registrations. At most 512 combined proposals plus the ordinary completion payload bound; truncation is reported. Selection replacement equals the issued range, without automatic reindentation. No LSP query, document opening, provider callback, executable command, installation, file edit or save. Personal editing uses snippets_user_read/save; file templates, external imports and automatic server merging remain unsupported.

operations.name: Snippets User Draft
operations.description: Capture one nonempty ordered UTF-16 selection from an already-open saved workspace document at expectedRevision into a personal snippet JSON draft. Reads the live source, including unsaved changes, without changing or saving it. Refuses untitled/external/SDK references, malformed ranges, split surrogates, selections over 8 KiB and escaped bodies over 8 KiB including the final caret. The shared literal escaping preserves dollar signs, backslashes, braces and Unicode; it creates no numbered editable field. Uses the host-configured personal store only; it must be readable valid JSON and have room under 256 definitions / 256 KiB. Adds a unique Selection snippet name, prefix snippet and the source language scope; existing definition values are retained and the complete draft is pretty-printed. Returns the original catalogue snapshot plus an editable draft, name and source provenance. Rechecks source revision/generation before return. Does not create directories, locks, files, plans or processes and never saves. Review the draft and use snippets_user_save with catalogue.revision and settings.write to persist; concurrent storage changes reject that save. The draft is an immutable captured copy, not a live source link.

operations.name: Build Location
operations.description: Resolve one compiler display line to an existing workspace file without executing tools or reading file contents. Supports explicit path(line,column), path:line:column, path:line, Rust arrows and GLSL ERROR/WARNING file prefixes, plus numeric MSBuild project prefixes. Coordinates are one-based reported compiler coordinates, not guaranteed Unicode character columns. text is limited natively to 16 KiB UTF-8 bytes with no NUL/newline/control bytes; directory defaults to workspace root, must already exist inside the workspace and is never guessed. Missing/external/symlink-escaping/URI paths and numeric shader source IDs are unmapped. No ANSI, tool code-page decoding, terminal, source-map or include/caret inference. A location does not establish a current diagnostic or source revision. GUI row activation uses the actual recorded live task directory when present; combined final logs use workspace root. Supplied text only; no process.execute permission needed.

operations.name: Build Output
operations.description: Read the latest explicit native build output tail without waiting for adapter/plugin/document locks. Retains at most 256 KiB of raw merged stdout/stderr in memory until the next build or workspace close. CMake configure/build/preset execution, MSBuild build/rebuild/clean/restore and explicit Unreal UBT/UAT execution opt in; tool discovery, structured evaluation, background analysis, project tasks and trusted plugin-owned processes are excluded. Initial requests use {}; conditional requests supply both streamId and revision. changed:true replaces the entire prior display tail; changed:false has empty output. A new streamId distinguishes builds even when operationId is reused. byteCount/droppedBytes count original bytes, not returned Unicode characters; text repairs invalid UTF-8, NUL/control bytes and may replace a split character at either retained edge. No ANSI/terminal interpretation, code-page detection, history archive, progress percentage, implicit artifact or SDK/MCP push notification. incomplete reports a journal failure; lifecycle/final exit remain available through the original build response. process.execute is required because compiler output can contain private project data. Poll at about 250 ms or slower; no cancellation or mutation of the running build.

operations.name: Build Cancel

operations.name: Build Configure
operations.description: Configure a trusted CMake project manually or through a configurePreset from build_presets. Presets retain native CMake cache/toolchain/environment/condition semantics; CyCode selects the guarded binaryDir and requests compilation/File API metadata. Executes project code. Saves the active profile after successful inspection. Manual mode refuses generator/compiler changes in an existing tree; CMake validates preset mode caches.
